title: Poppy JSON error
description: An error with a JSON body from an endpoint this protocol or an extension defines, such as conversations (spec 8.13), feedback (9.3), and the browser-session authorization (6), including invalid_session and session_ended (HTTP 400, spec 5.3 and 5.5, also at APIs) and extension_required (3.3). extension_required names the extension in extension, and direct_conversation_open names the open Direct Conversation in conversation_id (8.10). Unknown fields are allowed.
